name: Trickster's Dance
notes: Only one rank. Hunter-side learn spell on Wowhead: 1310617 ('Beast Training Abilities', level 20). Fox is a new family in Forever. warcraft.wiki.gg has no Trickster's Dance page (404).

Petopia Forever (wow-petopia.com/forever/abilities.php) lists ranks with pet level, TP cost and beasts per rank; beast NPC IDs come from its Wowhead Forever links. Petopia states its data comes from a limited beta and may change. Petopia gives no spell IDs. Its rank/beast lists are its own work, but its NPC IDs/links point to Wowhead.

wowhead-forever observations come from nether.wowhead.com/forever/tooltip/{spell,npc}/<id> (full www.wowhead.com pages return 403) and the www.wowhead.com/forever/search/suggestions-template endpoint (used for rank labels and spell IDs). Spell tooltips give 'Requires level N' (recorded as petLevel) and a 'Rank N' label; they do NOT show training point cost, so tp is null for wowhead-forever.

Wowhead NPC tooltips show level range, classification (Normal/Elite/Rare) and a zone ID only; they do not say which ability rank the beast teaches, so wowhead-forever beast observations have rank null (the list of beasts itself comes from Petopia). Zone IDs were turned into names with a fixed classic zone-ID table; Forever-only zone IDs were confirmed via Wowhead search (16591 Riverglades, 16593 Zephras Isle, 16611 Ruins of Lordaeron, 16550 The Drowned City, 16732 Excavation Site: Wetlands).
Petopia elite/rare flags come from its 'Rare Pets' and 'Elite Pets' browse pages (matched by name); when a beast is not on those pages the flag is omitted, not set false.
Blizzard announcement https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/news/24301515 confirms the ability name and family only (no ranks, levels, TP or beasts), so no blizzard observation rows were added.

Spell IDs recorded are the 'Pet Abilities' (pet-cast) spells. Wowhead also lists separate hunter-side 'Abilities' spells with the same name/rank (presumably the learn/teach spells); those are listed in notes, not in spellIds.
Petopia lists the TP cost of every rank of these Forever family abilities as 0.
